title: Github depreciation of actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-java@v4
body: I don't use GitHub Action from this repository for browser build, but I use my own custom action that is quite similar. I have noticed in my action what probably applies to one defined in aaps-ci.yml. Github action reports that there is incoming depreciation of actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-java@v4. This is my error message seen in action run: Would someone run official github browser build and confirm you have the same warning? If yes and if there is any volunteer to fix, aaps-ci.yml file should be updated to actions/checkout@v6 and actions/setup-java@v5. That worked for my personal action.

comments.body: I can see that @Angus-repo committed some work including this change int dev branch with 02f05a7c30ba735371b13a3c21ed3520de156917 (used checkout v5) so I'll assume the fix is heading the master branch way some time in the future
